causal_clock.wrap: a backwards jump > 1 s from within 5 s of 2^32 us to under 5 s
causal_clock.reboot: any other backwards jump > 1 s: restart

settings.pca_rule: per-window PCA of the band-passed 103 entries, mean-centred, sign set so skewness is positive; PCs 2 to 4 kept, PC1 discarded
settings.log_rule: log(magnitude + 1e-6 x the map's median magnitude), minus the map's mean
settings.fusion: the equal-weight sum of the eight components' log-probabilities, normalised; the decision is its argmax
settings.displayed_confidence: softmax(sum / 8): the geometric mean of the eight; it never changes the decision

engine_v4.window: [t0, t0 + 4.0 s], decided at its end by the causal clock; it stops at the next start press if that press is already pending
engine_v4.direction: RX2's 10 to 35 Hz energy slope on the first 3.0 s, at that 3 s window's own decision time (as engine v3)

end_detector.reference: median energy over frames centred up to 2.5 s
end_detector.end: first run of 10 frames below alpha x reference, starting at or after 2.5 s
end_detector.alpha_rule: fitted on each fold's training sessions only (window and gait brief, 1 Oct)

engine_v4.wifi_speed: the torso contour median on the best link for the direction's path, on [t0, the detected end] (the whole window without one), x lambda / (2F)
engine_v4.fixes_carried: engine v3's fix L (per-layout calibration pools) and fix F (no rhythm, no step rate)

cnn_3link.input: 3 x 28 frequencies x 34 frames, plus a 2-value direction flag

cnn_1link.input: 1 x 28 frequencies x 34 frames, plus a 2-value direction flag

cnn_training.optimiser: Adam, lr 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4, cosine to 0

components.rf: random forest, 300 trees, max_features sqrt, random_state 0; 630 gait columns; per-path z (training statistics)
components.rf_pace_prior: the same forest; 630 gait + Wi-Fi speed; session standardisation
components.et_pace_prior: extra trees, 300 trees, sqrt, random_state 0; 630 + Wi-Fi speed; session standardisation
components.lda_pace_prior: LDA, solver lsqr, shrinkage auto (Ledoit-Wolf); 630 + Wi-Fi speed; session standardisation
components.cnn: CNN-v2 on the 3-link maps, seeds 0 to 2, plain
components.cnn_prior: the same nets with AdaBN on the calibration windows
components.cnn_perlink_prior: one 1-link CNN-v2 per receiver (3 seeds each), AdaBN, the three links' log-probabilities summed

cadence_resolver_bias.sentence: On the 55 natural identification walks whose Doppler-band energy envelope shows a clear step or stride rhythm, the feature bank's resolved cadence agrees with the envelope's within 10 % on 29 % of walks and is half or double it (step against stride) on 0 %; the ratio's median is 0.88 (interquartile 0.76 to 0.95), so the resolver does not confuse step with stride; it runs low, by a median 12 %.
